title: haworthia retusa var. mirabilis
intro: Haworthia retusa var. mirabilis, commonly known as the "Zebra Plant" or "Mirabilis Plant", is a succulent plant species belonging to the Asphodelaceae family. This plant is valued for its unique, striped pattern on its leaves, which are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Haworthia retusa var. mirabilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate stress, while its therapeutic actions include antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
